environment.description: Flask application deployed as a Kubernetes Deployment in namespace 'asset-search' on a cluster running k8s 1.24 with no PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforcement. The pod runs with default security context (no restrictions). Ingress is a basic nginx-ingress with no ModSecurity or WAF rules. Service is exposed via ClusterIP with port-forward for internal users. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured.
